answer.rationale: Write-path p99 is 5x and described as confined to the primary region, which matches the March regional-degradation analog (b2) better than the other archived plays. Rollback is unavailable because the in-flight build is a non-revertible security patch, so b1 is not actionable. Circuit breaking (b4) would shed checkout/settlement writes and violates the no-lost-writes objective. Read-replica routing (b5) addressed report/dashboard load, not a write-heavy settlement peak. Pre-peak headroom (b3) is a different timing and does not establish that adding capacity inside an already-sick primary would restore the write path. Remaining uncertainties: whether the secondary is on the same patch, replication lag under peak settlement writes, and whether “primary region” is simply where writes live. Verify b2 before a larger cutover; start with a small guarded shift so write loss and downstream settlement value can be watched.
